top.title: Cloudflare lays out a trust framework for AI agents
top.summary: As agents act on behalf of users, sites struggle to verify who an agent represents, whether to trust it and who is accountable. Cloudflare proposes a delegation model to fix that.
top.why: Agent accountability is the heart of the orchestration story, and the same questions apply to the guardrails for PMM's own agents: whose authority is it acting on, and where does a human sign off.

top.title: Cognition: writing code is only 23% of engineering agent hours
top.summary: Five months of Global 1000 data on Devin cloud agents shows most productive hours go to planning, testing, security and deployment, and cost per session fell as usage grew.
top.why: Evidence that agent value sits in the end-to-end process, not the single task. Useful proof point for orchestration messaging and a model for how to report agent ROI.

top.title: Companies further along with AI lean on Claude
top.summary: In a survey of 4,117 business leaders, Claude use rises from 58% at the exploring stage to 86% among companies running AI in daily operations. ChatGPT stays flat around 70%, and most teams use both.
top.why: A ready-made maturity baseline for the PMM ops dashboard and a talking point for enablement: teams that scale assign different jobs to different tools.

try_this.title: Map the context before you build the agent
try_this.how: A vendor piece argues MCP connectors alone leave agents guessing. Before the first CI agent, list where approved positioning, launch plans and field content live and which version is canonical.

workflows.title: Cursor now builds and deploys shareable live apps
workflows.summary: Describe a tool and Cursor builds it, sets up a database, runs security checks and deploys it behind a link.
workflows.why: Lowers the bar for internal PMM tools like intake forms or CI trackers. Worth a governance check before teams start shipping their own.

workflows.title: Headroom trims what agents read from tool output
workflows.summary: An open-source layer compresses tool results before they hit the model, cutting token spend on long agent runs.
workflows.why: Relevant once PMM agents pull large docs or call logs and usage costs start to show up.

governance.title: Midterms shift Congress toward tighter AI rules
governance.summary: Democrats won Congress, and incoming lawmakers promise hearings and possibly a development pause. Voters rejected 40 of 41 data center measures.
governance.why: Expect Legal and Security to ask harder questions. Build the AI usage policy so it can absorb new rules without a rewrite.

measurement.title: Usage and outcome pricing complicate revenue rules
measurement.summary: Credits, overages and pay-per-resolution pricing each force finance to make a call on what counts as revenue and when.
measurement.why: Context for how AI-native competitors package and price, and how their sales teams will pitch it.

landscape.title: METR: Anthropic's AI R&D is accelerating
landscape.summary: An independent review finds model gains on well-defined tasks are arriving about twice as fast as in 2024-2025, largely because AI now does more of the R&D.
landscape.why: Tool capabilities will keep shifting under your workflows. Version and re-test skills on a schedule.

landscape.title: Anthropic IPO valuation likely to come in lower
landscape.summary: Investors expect about $80B raised at closer to $1T, below the $1.5T target, ahead of a listing planned for the week before Thanksgiving.
